description: A multiplex agent-based simulation on a social network with three layers (family, work/school, community). Agents update mask-wearing behavior daily via logistic adoption/discontinuation hazards driven by layer-weighted neighbor adoption, individual risk perception, received information, and a government intervention that increases broadcast information starting on Day 10. Parameters are calibrated from days 0–29 and used to predict days 30–39.

behaviors.name: receive_information
behaviors.description: Agents update their information state based on exogenous broadcast and peer spillover with short memory.

parameters.info_persistence: probability info persists to next day (0–1), to_be_calibrated

behaviors.algorithm: For each agent i on day t: 1) Compute peer_info_share_i(t-1) = weighted fraction of neighbors (across layers) who had received_info=1 at t-1. 2) Set rho_t = rho_broadcast_before if t < gov_intervention_day else rho_broadcast_after. 3) Compute p_info_i(t) = 1 - (1 - rho_t) * (1 - phi_peer * peer_info_share_i(t-1)). 4) Sample received_info_i(t) ~ Bernoulli( max( received_info_i(t-1) * info_persistence, p_info_i(t) ) ).

behaviors.name: decide_adoption
behaviors.description: Unmasked agents decide whether to adopt masks given neighbors' mask shares by layer, risk, info, demographics, and policy shift.

parameters.policy_logit_shift: additional logit shift after intervention, to_be_calibrated
parameters.layer_weights_by_age_group: dict of adjustments, calibrated or specified

behaviors.algorithm: For each unmasked agent i on day t: 1) Compute neighbor_mask_share_l(i,t) for each layer l in {family, work_school, community}. 2) Compute layer-weighted peer signal S_i(t) = beta_family * share_family + beta_work_school * share_work_school + beta_community * share_community. 3) Compute info_effect_i(t) = theta_info if received_info_i(t - info_lag_days) = 1 else 0. 4) Compute logit p01_i(t) = alpha0 + alpha_occ[occupation_i] + gamma_risk * risk_perception_i + S_i(t) + info_effect_i(t) + policy_logit_shift * I(t >= gov_intervention_day). 5) Convert to probability via sigmoid and sample adoption_i(t) ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(logit)). If 1, set wearing_mask_i(t+1) = 1.

behaviors.name: decide_discontinuation
behaviors.description: Masked agents decide whether to stop wearing masks with persistence and modifiers from peers and information.

parameters.delta_info: log-odds decrease in discontinuation when informed (expected < 0), to_be_calibrated
parameters.delta_peer: log-odds decrease per unit neighbor masked share (expected < 0), to_be_calibrated

behaviors.algorithm: For each masked agent i on day t: 1) If min_wear_duration_days > 0 and (t - last_state_change_day_i) < min_wear_duration_days, set wearing_mask_i(t+1)=1 (lock-in). Else: 2) Compute peer_mask_share_all(i,t). 3) Compute logit p10_i(t) = delta0 + delta_info * received_info_i(t) + delta_peer * peer_mask_share_all(i,t). 4) Sample discontinue_i(t) ~ Bernoulli(sigmoid(logit)). If 1, set wearing_mask_i(t+1)=0; else 1.

behaviors.name: update_layer_weights_by_demographics
behaviors.description: Adjust layer influence weights by age group and occupation to reflect contact salience.

parameters.age_group_adjustments: dict, e.g., students: +0.2 to work_school, -0.1 family, -0.1 community; retirees: +0.1 family, -0.1 work_school

behaviors.algorithm: On initialization and optionally at policy changes, set layer_weights_i = normalized(base_layer_weights + adjustment[age_group_i]). Use these weights when aggregating neighbor info and mask shares.

behaviors.name: broadcast_information_schedule
behaviors.description: Government sets day-dependent broadcast rate and optional policy behavior shift.
behaviors.algorithm: For each day t: if t < intervention_start_day, set rho_t = rho_broadcast_before and policy shifts = 0; else set rho_t = rho_broadcast_after, add policy_logit_shift to adoption logits, optionally multiply beta_work_school or layer weight for work/school if a workplace mandate scenario is used.

interactions.name: peer_social_influence
interactions.description: Neighbors' mask-wearing increases adoption propensity through layer-specific shares.
interactions.effect: Modifies adoption logit via beta_family, beta_work_school, beta_community times layer-specific masked neighbor shares.

interactions.name: peer_information_spillover
interactions.description: Neighbors who are informed increase the probability an agent receives information.
interactions.effect: Increases received_info probability via phi_peer times weighted neighbor info share; strength may rise after Day 10.

interactions.name: government_broadcast
interactions.description: Exogenous information broadcast increases probability of receiving information after intervention.
interactions.effect: Sets broadcast probability rho_t and adds policy_logit_shift to adoption logit to reflect government guidance/mandates.

steps: Load agent_attributes.csv; create one Agent per row with demographics, risk_perception, and degrees.
Load social_network.json; parse layer-specific adjacency lists; enforce no self-loops, deduplicate, symmetrize if specified; recompute 'all'.
Join train_data.csv for days 0–29 to establish initial wearing_mask and received_info trajectories; for day 0 state, prefer initial_mask_wearing if present, else earliest train_data state.
Set layer_weights by age group adjustments; normalize per agent.
Fit calibration models (adoption and discontinuation hazards, information dynamics) using days 0–29.
Initialize Government parameters (broadcast rates and policy shift) with calibrated or scenario values.
Set simulation clock to day 0 with states from data; run through day 29 to align; then simulate predictions for days 30–39.

algorithms.compute_neighbor_mask_shares: For each agent and layer l, share_l = masked_neighbors_l / max(1, degree_l). If degree_l=0, share_l=0.
algorithms.compute_peer_info_share: Weighted fraction of neighbors with received_info=1 using agent's layer_weights or contact frequencies.
algorithms.update_information_state: Apply receive_information behavior with broadcast rho_t and peer spillover phi_peer and persistence.
algorithms.adoption_decision_rule: Apply decide_adoption behavior on unmasked agents using logistic model with layer-specific shares, risk, occupation, info, and policy shift.
algorithms.discontinuation_decision_rule: Apply decide_discontinuation behavior on masked agents using logistic model with peer and information modifiers.
algorithms.simulate_day: Synchronous update: 1) compute all neighbor shares from states at t; 2) update info states; 3) compute adoption/discontinuation probabilities; 4) sample transitions; 5) commit states for t+1.
algorithms.fit_parameters: Fit discrete-time logistic regressions: (a) adoption on transitions 0->1 with predictors: received_info (current/lagged), layer shares, risk, occupation, interactions; (b) discontinuation on 1->0 with similar predictors; (c) info receipt with broadcast proxy (day fixed effects or pre/post Day 10 indicator) and peer info share. Use time-split validation.
algorithms.predict_days_30_39: Starting from observed states on day 29, simulate days 30–39 using calibrated parameters and the intervention schedule; output per-agent and aggregate adoption rates.
algorithms.evaluate_predictions: Compute daily aggregate adoption and compare to actual for days 30–39 using RMSE; compute predicted vs actual peak adoption rate and time-to-peak over the evaluation window.

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agents' demographics, risk, and initial mask state if provided; derive degree targets and demographic adjustments.

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Provide multiplex neighbor lists by layer for influence and information dynamics.

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Calibrate behavior and information transition models using days 0–29; supply initial states and validation.

files.name: config.yaml
files.description: Holds all configurable parameters, intervention schedule, and file paths.

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Parse CSV/JSON, coerce types, perform data hygiene, and join datasets.

files.name: network_builder.py
files.description: Build multiplex graph structures, symmetrize edges, compute degrees, and provide neighbor query utilities.

files.name: entities.py
files.description: Define Agent and Government classes and their attributes.

files.name: dynamics.py
files.description: Implement behaviors and daily synchronous update logic (information update, adoption, discontinuation).

files.name: calibration.py
files.description: Fit logistic models for adoption, discontinuation, and information; export calibrated parameters.

files.name: simulate.py
files.description: Run the simulation for training alignment and prediction windows; manage random seeds and outputs.

files.name: metrics.py
files.description: Compute RMSE, Peak Adoption Rate Error, and Time-to-Peak Error; optionally micro-level metrics.

files.name: evaluation.py
files.description: Load predictions and ground truth (days 30–39) and report evaluation metrics.

files.name: utils.py
files.description: Common utilities: sigmoid, safe division, normalization, logging.
